title: Watering can
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- watering can body -->
  <rect x='25' y='45' width='45' height='38' rx='8' fill='#3fa9f5'/>
  <rect x='30' y='50' width='35' height='10' rx='4' fill='#7fd2ff'/>
  <circle cx='47' cy='67' r='5' fill='#1b6fa8'/>
  <circle cx='47' cy='67' r='2.5' fill='#bdefff'/>

  <!-- top rim / opening -->
  <rect x='29' y='40' width='37' height='9' rx='4' fill='#2b8edb'/>
  <rect x='34' y='42' width='27' height='4' rx='2' fill='#9fe3ff'/>

  <!-- handle -->
  <path d='M28 50 C13 48 13 72 28 72' stroke='#1f7fc4' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M28 50 C16 49 16 70 28 71' stroke='#69c8ff' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- spout -->
  <path d='M70 55 L90 35' stroke='#2b8edb' stroke-width='10' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M70 55 L90 35' stroke='#7fd2ff' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- spout head / rose -->
  <circle cx='91' cy='33' r='8' fill='#4fb7f2'/>
  <circle cx='91' cy='33' r='4' fill='#bdefff'/>
  <circle cx='87' cy='29' r='1.2' fill='#e8fbff'/>
  <circle cx='92' cy='28' r='1.2' fill='#e8fbff'/>
  <circle cx='96' cy='33' r='1.2' fill='#e8fbff'/>
  <circle cx='87' cy='37' r='1.2' fill='#e8fbff'/>
  <circle cx='92' cy='38' r='1.2' fill='#e8fbff'/>

  <!-- water drops -->
  <ellipse cx='84' cy='47' rx='2' ry='4' fill='#8fe8ff'/>
  <ellipse cx='79' cy='55' rx='1.6' ry='3.2' fill='#8fe8ff'/>
  <ellipse cx='91' cy='49' rx='1.6' ry='3.2' fill='#8fe8ff'/>

  <!-- little shine on body -->
  <rect x='31' y='56' width='4' height='12' rx='2' fill='#c4f1ff'/>
</svg>
